layouts.name: Reno Fernley E
layouts.description: The identified historical E course retains the Western long narrow return, upper Western short loop, inner middle S, Southern linking bend and complete Eastern middle straight. The original operator roadcourse plan establishes the old-sector and alternate Southern connections. The Northeastern full loop, upper Northern S and Southwestern terminal loop are excluded. All course pixels are independently inspected pavement centerline anchors on public-domain 2022 NAIP imagery; comparison diagrams supply branch identity only. Fine corner, old timing extent, degraded pavement and temporary barrier alignment remain draft, without scaling to the catalogue distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2767.1 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
